citation: OECD/Eurostat. (2018). Oslo Manual 2018: Guidelines for collecting, reporting and using data on innovation (4th ed.). OECD Publishing.
supports: Implementation distinguishes innovation from a concept or prototype; novelty can be relative to the firm, market or world. Routine changes are insufficient.
limit: Does not supply a universal numeric threshold for breakthrough or forecast this fictional firm's outcome.

citation: Yao, S., Zhao, J., Yu, D., Du, N., Shafran, I., Narasimhan, K., & Cao, Y. (2023). ReAct: Synergizing reasoning and acting in language models. ICLR.
supports: A language model can interleave reasoning and actions, use tools, observe outcomes and revise its plan.
limit: The cited experiments do not measure chart-review accuracy, commercial demand or financial-services workflow performance.

citation: Christensen, C. M., Raynor, M. E., & McDonald, R. (2015). What is disruptive innovation? Harvard Business Review, 93(12), 44-53.
locator: Sections on low-end/new-market footholds and disruption as a process
supports: Christensen-style disruption requires a market trajectory; technical novelty or a successful efficiency improvement alone does not establish it.
limit: The course's broad creative-destruction lens can describe task displacement without establishing this narrower theory.

citation: Brynjolfsson, E., Li, D., & Raymond, L. (2025). Generative AI at work. The Quarterly Journal of Economics, 140(2), 889-942. https://doi.org/10.1093/qje/qjae044
locator: Abstract and Introduction, sample and external-validity qualifications
supports: In one firm, AI-assisted customer-support workers had heterogeneous productivity effects; the reported average was 15% across 5,172 workers.
limit: Human support agents are workers, not autonomous software agents. This is not chart-workflow evidence and does not establish employment, wage or business-model displacement.

citation: Anthropic. (2024, October 22). Introducing computer use, a new Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude 3.5 Haiku.
locator: Computer use introduction and public beta limitations
supports: A vendor offered model-directed computer interaction through a public beta, documenting a commercialization pathway for tool-using AI.
limit: A release announcement does not establish market-wide adoption, current product status, reliability or a new business model for the case organization.
